flame_sweep.name: Flame Sweep
flame_sweep.description: A fire-attribute attack. Sweeps the area in front of you with a powerful flame. Enemies struck by the flame are burned and take continuous damage.

mages_teaching.name: Magician's Teaching
mages_teaching.description: 25% chance to trigger on skill use; each stack grants +3% Damage and +3% Ignore Defense, up to 3 stacks (+9% / +9% at max).

fervent_drain.name: Fervent Drain
fervent_drain.description: Passive: +5% Final Damage per DoT active on the target (up to 5 stacks / +25%; different FD sources multiply).

linkSkill.noLinkForJob: This job has no link skill.

rune_persistence.name: Rune Persistence
rune_persistence.flavor: Increases the duration of Liberated Rune Power.

elven_blessing.name: Elven Blessing
elven_blessing.flavor: Whisks you back to Elluel and blesses you with extra EXP gains through the power of Elven lore.
elven_blessing.caveat: Owner cooldown: 600 sec. Linked cooldown: 1800 sec.

desc.2: Returns you to Elluel (Cooldown: 1800 sec). EXP +15% permanently.
desc.3: Returns you to Elluel (Cooldown: 1800 sec). EXP +20% permanently.

phantom_instinct.name: Phantom Instinct
phantom_instinct.flavor: Uses phenomenal insight to locate an enemy's critical weakness.

light_wash.name: Light Wash
light_wash.flavor: The power of light breaks down enemy DEF, allowing your attacks to penetrate.

close_call.name: Close Call
close_call.flavor: Grants you a chance to survive an attack that would have been fatal.

knights_watch.name: Knight's Watch
knights_watch.flavor: Mihile, Knight of Light, temporarily grants you Status Resistance.
knights_watch.caveat: Owner's version is an active barrier; linked version grants only the Status Resistance buff.

cygnus_blessing.flavor: Blessings from an awakened Empress Cygnus protect you from harm.

invincible_belief.caveat: Does not activate in towns or while affected by statuses that prevent HP recovery. Not affected by cooldown resets, buff duration increases, or recovery-skill amplifiers.
